title: Non-Abelian Anyon Braiding in Resonant Topological Superconductors
abstract: We formulate a unified Hamiltonian describing Majorana zero modes in 1D semiconductor-superconductor nanowires subjected to localized periodic acoustic modulation. Dynamic acoustic phononic pumping demonstrates adiabatic gate fidelity exceeding 99.98% against thermal phase slip perturbations.

title: Deterministic Multi-Qubit Entanglement via Cavity Resonator Phase Locking
abstract: Investigation into multi-qubit Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger (GHZ) state synthesis utilizing microwave cavity ringdown interference. Demonstrates scalable 16-qubit quantum state tomography with suppressed cross-talk decoherence.

title: Quantum Reservoir Computing on Disordered Spin Chains for Time-Series Inference
abstract: A framework for training continuous-variable quantum reservoirs on noisy biological time-series data. The transverse-field Ising spin chain operates as a nonlinear kernel mapping physiological micro-fluctuations into separable Hilbert spaces.

title: Continuous-Variable Quantum Teleportation Across Dissipative Optomechanical Bridges
abstract: Experimental architecture realizing high-efficiency continuous-variable teleportation of coherent acoustic phononic states using optomechanical microcavities coupled to high-Q quartz resonators.

title: Surface Code Parity Tracking with Real-Time Neural Syndrome Decoders
abstract: Sub-microsecond neural syndromic decoding on FPGA hardware for rotated surface codes, achieving near-optimal threshold protection against correlated flux-noise bursts.

title: Parametric Modal Symmetry in Nonlinear Chladni Resonators
abstract: Analytical and computational exploration of high-order vibrational Chladni nodal patterns on anisotropic elastic plates subjected to dual-frequency harmonic excitation. Nodal bifurcations reveal quantized geometric transitions.

title: Faraday Wave Solitons and Discrete Particle Trapping in Resonant Fluid Interfaces
abstract: High-speed holographic imaging of standing Faraday wave solitons in viscous liquid layers driven by multi-tone acoustic transducers. Demonstrates localized hydrodynamic particle trapping and programmable particulate self-assembly.

title: Cymatic Biometric Encryption: Multi-Modal Frequency Key Generation
abstract: A novel cryptographic key derivation function based on unique vibrational acoustic transfer functions of human craniofacial and cranial bone conduction resonances.

title: Phased-Array Ultrasonic Manipulation of Viscoelastic Micro-Droplets in 3D Space
abstract: Volumetric acoustic levitation system employing 256 ultrasonic transducers at 40 kHz, allowing contact-free manipulation, coalescence, and phase transitions of biological samples.

title: Auditory Geometry: Higher-Order Topological Invariants in Polyphonic Harmonic Fields
abstract: Constructing mathematical bridges between musical micro-intervals, projective geometry, and spectral topology. Introduces the Resonance Manifold mapping timbre to Riemannian curvature.

title: Continuous Phase Coherence Dynamics in Multi-Channel EEG During Sonic Meditation
abstract: High-density 64-channel EEG tracking of inter-hemispheric phase synchronization during exposure to low-frequency isochronic acoustic stimuli. Documents persistent theta-gamma cross-frequency phase-amplitude coupling.

title: Wavelet-Based Continuous Heart Rate Variability Decomposition for Autonomic Tone Assessment
abstract: Continuous-wavelet transform (CWT) decomposition of ultra-short photoplethysmogram (PPG) tachograms for real-time monitoring of sympathetic and parasympathetic balance in high-stress immersion environments.

title: Closed-Loop Auditory Neurostimulation for Sleep Architecture Optimization
abstract: Real-time acoustic phase-locked pink noise bursts delivered during non-REM slow-wave sleep enhance slow-wave delta oscillation power by 34% without triggering cortical arousals.

title: Micro-Galvanic Skin Conductance Fluctuation as an Indicator of Semantic Saliency in Virtual Spatial Audio
abstract: High-resolution tonic and phasic electrodermal response modeling during spatial sound trajectory transitions in virtual auditory reality.

title: Latent Manifold Alignment for Zero-Shot Non-Invasive BCI Intention Decoding
abstract: Geometric deep learning architecture aligning neural manifold trajectories across multi-session EEG recordings, enabling robust motor and auditory imagination decoding without session recalibration.

title: Spiking Neuromorphic Transformers for Energy-Efficient Acoustic Event Localization
abstract: Event-driven spiking neural network transformer deployed on neuromorphic silicon (Intel Loihi 2), achieving 12-microsecond spatial sound localization with sub-milliwatt power dissipation.
source: IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems

title: Diffusion-Driven Auditory Texture Synthesis Conditioned on Real-Time Biosignal Topography
abstract: A generative audio diffusion pipeline conditioned on latent physiological embeddings (EEG alpha/theta ratios, respiration cadence) synthesizing continuous, non-repeating acoustic landscapes for restorative cognitive states.

title: Cognitive Workload Estimation via Multi-Modal Eye Tracking and Pupil Diameter Spectral Dynamics
abstract: Transformer-based fusion of high-speed infrared pupil dynamics and blink interval histograms for real-time cognitive overload detection in complex multi-agent collaborative workflows.

title: Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning Engine for Scientific Hypothesis Generation in Resonant Systems
abstract: Integration of large language models with formal symbolic algebra engines (SymPy/Z3) to deduce novel physical invariants and conservation laws from raw experimental sensor streams.

title: Anisotropic Acoustic Metamaterials for Asymmetric Sound Cloaking and Beamforming
abstract: Sub-wavelength labyrinthine acoustic metamaterial unit cells configured to induce giant non-reciprocal acoustic refraction and complete reflection suppression across a 500 Hz - 4 kHz band.

title: Long-Range Infrasound Propagation Modeling Through Atmospheric Waveguides and Inversion Layers
abstract: Parabolic equation ray-tracing method for infrasonic acoustic energy propagation under nocturnal boundary layer thermal inversions, validating seismic-acoustic coupling mechanisms.
source: The Journal of the Acoustical Society of America

title: Cavitation Bubble Dynamics and Harmonic Sonoluminescence in Degassed Deuterated Solvents
abstract: High-speed strobe microscopy of single-bubble acoustic cavitation excited by 28 kHz ultrasound in deuterated acetone, documenting extreme optical emission flash durations below 100 picoseconds.

title: Spatialized Wave Field Synthesis for High-Density Immersive Reverberant Fields
abstract: High-order ambisonic decoding and boundary element acoustic holographic rendering utilizing a 64-channel concentric transducer ring, yielding transparent holographic sound field reproduction.
source: Journal of the Audio Engineering Society

title: Magneto-Inertial Confinement Plasma Stabilization via Resonant Acoustic Wave Pumping
abstract: Application of high-frequency megawatt acoustic standing waves within a liquid lithium vortex to stabilize Rayleigh-Taylor and sausage instabilities during pulsed magneto-inertial plasma compression.

title: Thermal-Hydraulic Harmonic Resonance in Advanced Molten Salt Civil Reactor Cores
abstract: Nonlinear oscillation analysis of coupled neutron flux and thermal-hydraulic flow in graphite-moderated fluoride salt reactors. Proves self-limiting stability regimes under severe acoustic perturbation.

title: Muon-Catalyzed Fusion Rate Optimization in High-Density Resonant Deuterium-Tritium Targets
abstract: Modeling the resonant formation of dt-mu mesomolecules in cryogenically cooled, acoustically modulated liquid D-T mixtures, predicting an effective alpha-sticking probability reduction by 28%.

title: Ultrasonic Waveguide Sensors for In-Core Real-Time Temperature and Viscosity Tomography
abstract: High-temperature magnetostrictive ultrasonic waveguides operating reliably up to 850 deg C inside liquid metal fast-breeder reactor simulators, delivering distributed temperature measurements with 0.5 deg C accuracy.
source: IEEE Transactions on Instrumentation and Measurement

title: Modulation of Low-Energy Nuclear Decay Channels via Extreme Acoustic Cavitation Fields
abstract: Empirical investigation testing the hypotheses of altered beta-decay and electron-capture half-lives under multi-gigapascal transient acoustic cavitation collapse pressures.
